values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hogislandpoint ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Hog Island State Forest Campground, Mackinac: 42 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in paddling access at the day-use area, about 200 ft from the parking area; day-use picnic area with tables, a fire ring and a charcoal grill on the east side.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hogislandpoint ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Carry-in access is located at the day-use area, approximately 200 feet from the parking area.' 'A picnic area is located on the east side of the campground and includes three picnic tables, one fire ring and one charcoal grill.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hogislandpoint ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Hog Island: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 42 sites 'for tents and small trailers' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hogislandpoint ('With 42 sites for tents and small trailers, many offer direct access to the water'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (42 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Lake Michigan shoreline, 7.7 mi E of Naubinway on US-2 (Mackinac County); managed by Straits State Park. Many sites have direct access to the water (sites 7 and 32 are pull-through); part of the shoreline is rocky, with a sandy beach by the day-use picnic area on the east side. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 42 tent/small-trailer sites (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches. Phone 906-643-8620 matches (Straits SP). Pull-through (derived from the note) left: the page is silent. Note trimmed of field restatements and its stale '~$15/night'.
